title_en: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
excerpt_en: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.

title_en: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
excerpt_en: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

title_en: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
excerpt_en: An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital on Wednesday night killed six people, injured 27 others and caused extensive damage.

title_en: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
excerpt_en: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.

title_en: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says
excerpt_en: The Israeli military says its soldiers opened fire at individuals “who intended to hurl stones” at a road used by Israelis.

title_en: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
excerpt_en: Three children are among those killed in the incident that came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza.

title_en: ‘For the first time I have my own chair’: Gaza siblings find new freedom
excerpt_en: In Gaza, 10-year-old Anas is one of three siblings born without legs and with only two fingers on each of their hands. They struggle to move around and perform daily activities like eating and writing independently.

title_en: Gunfire damages tents at Rafah displacement site in Gaza, as aid teams prepare for winter storms
excerpt_en: Gunfire hit and damaged multiple tents at a displacement site in Gaza’s northern Rafah region on Tuesday, reportedly causing injuries and forcing a humanitarian partner to leave the area, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has said.

title_en: UN rights office warns of deepening displacement ‘nightmare’ in Gaza
excerpt_en: Israeli forces continue to push Palestinians into ever-smaller areas of the Gaza Strip while destroying civilian infrastructure and attacking displacement sites, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, warned on Friday amid concerns of ethnic cleansing.

title_en: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied
excerpt_en: Families in Gaza are bracing for a fourth winter in tents and makeshift shelters as UN aid operations face mounting obstacles, with transport suspended on Tuesday due to Israel’s closure of the key Kerem Shalom crossing for election day.

title_en: West Bank: Hebron crackdown displaces thousands, Türk warns of ethnic cleansing
excerpt_en: Israel’s “aggressive operation” in the West Bank city of Hebron raises serious concerns of ethnic cleansing, UN human rights chief Volker Türk warned on Monday, as the number of Palestinians forced from their homes passed 3,000 on the eve of Israeli elections.

title_en: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
excerpt_en: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.

title_en: ‘Ominous start’ to West Bank olive harvest amid settler attacks
excerpt_en: The use of live ammunition, arson and the destruction of centuries-old olive trees have marked the opening weeks of this year’s harvest in the occupied West Bank.

title_en: ‘Season of fear’: Escalating Israeli attacks on West Bank olive farmers, deadly strikes on Gaza
excerpt_en: Israeli attacks on war-torn Gaza over the weekend killed at least six Palestinians, including children, despite a year-old ceasefire agreement. Meanwhile, in the occupied West Bank, settler violence continued through the ongoing olive harvest, with UN independent experts on Monday urging Israel to protect Palestinian farmers.

title_en: Gaza: Funding cuts leave half a million without food assistance
excerpt_en: Funding shortages have forced the World Food Programme (WFP) to slash assistance to hungry families in the Gaza Strip by roughly one third – a move that will affect some 500,000 people as winter approaches, the UN agency announced on Monday.

title_en: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter
excerpt_en: Like many people in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, Ahmed Al-Omari is preparing for another winter of bitter cold and rain that threatens to cause flooding as families struggle to survive in tattered tents and damaged buildings.
